DESCRIPTION.SUPPACK_GUIVRE_BUILDING_DESC:
Long before our realm came to be, stories were told of the Guivre, a majestic jewelled serpentine beast, sporting wings so vast and talons so sharp that it could swipe sheep right under the nose of unwary shepherds!

Nowadays, whether out of awe or fear, villagers build these impressive monuments to honour the mighty serpent.
DESCRIPTION.SUPPACK_GUIVRE_DECORATIVE_DESC: More decorations for the Guivre Garden, so your statues can have a tiny world of their own.
DESCRIPTION.SUPPACK_GUIVRE_STATUE_DESC: Some say these statues look majestic, while others find them terrifying, but one thing is clear: they leave no one stone-cold.
